hook.name: Incinerator
hook.description: Buy-and-burn hook that extracts a 2.2% fee on ETH buys into a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn, and a 2.2% token fee on sells for immediate burning via delta returns. Contains a hidden mechanism: once `registerBurner()` is called (callable by anyone), sells by non-whitelisted addresses revert in `afterSwap`, creating a potential honeypot controlled by the deployer.
